headline: US Lawmakers Propose Sweeping Ban on DUV Chipmaking Tool Exports to China
summary: A bipartisan proposal to ban DUV lithography and etching tool exports to leading Chinese firms marks a significant escalation in the tech trade war, directly impacting China's semiconductor manufacturing capabilities and global supply chain logistics.
